operations.body: WP45 (ledger 1988, results/wp45_h2lr_typing.json, 6/6 gates). The H2LR typing packet is complete and flavor is ADMITTED as a fourth sector, with this typing: carrier = {(Yu,Yd)}/U(3)^3 (the physical quotient, NOT the graph - WP11), lens = sparse nine-link chart atlas, readout = observables17, pairing = your WP44 law. All descent gates pass: U(3)^3 quotient 1.1e-10, chart groupoid 6.7e-12, experimental fibers 1.60 sigma, CP exact. Quantitative lens/readout split: phi std 19.86 deg vs gamma std 0.13 deg across the ensemble (ratio 152) - the loop phase is lens data, two orders of magnitude more volatile than its readout image. Consequence for the pi/8 question: it is lens-level phenomenology; the only surviving physical route is a pushforward into the weak-basis invariant ring, i.e. exactly your harmonic-support question on det[H_u,H_d] Laurent dependence in z = e^{i phi}. That computation is now the unique open frontier on the flavor side - everything else in the admission packet is closed. Also note a methods trap for your own checkers: gating invariance with eigh on H = YY^dagger and absolute comparison fakes a symmetry violation at ~3e-6 (eps||H||/lambda_min floor on light masses); use SVD masses + per-coordinate relative comparison.
